_note: B-Fit exercise catalog — finite, hardcoded/seeded with the app. Fields: id (slug), name, group, subGroup (nullable). image/animation/description added later with assets.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
howto: Lie on the bench, eyes under the bar, feet planted.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder-width; retract + squeeze your shoulder blades throughout.
Lower the bar to mid-chest, elbows about 45° from your torso.
Press up and slightly back until arms are straight; never bounce the bar.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
howto: Set the bench at 30–45°; grip just outside shoulder-width.
Pinch your shoulder blades and plant your feet.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, elbows tucked ~45°.
Press up to lockout, keeping your head and hips on the bench.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
howto: Secure your feet under the pads; grip just outside shoulder-width.
Keep shoulder blades retracted and the bar over your mid/lower chest.
Lower in a straight line, elbows at ~45°.
Press straight up to lockout; avoid arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
howto: Kick the dumbbells to shoulder line, feet planted, shoulder blades retracted.
Press the weights straight up until arms are straight, knuckles slightly inward.
Lower with control until your elbows reach just below the bench line.
Keep the weights moving in a straight, balanced line.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
howto: Lie on an incline bench at 30–45°, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press up and slightly together toward your upper chest.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the upper chest.
Keep your shoulder blades retracted; don't let your elbows flare wide.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
howto: Lie flat, dumbbells held straight above your chest, palms facing.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows for the whole set.
Lower the weights out to your sides in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Reverse the arc back to the top, squeezing your chest.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
howto: Set the bench at 30–45°; hold dumbbells above your chest, palms in.
With soft elbows, lower them out to the sides until a gentle chest stretch.
Keep the arc constant; don't let the elbows drop below your shoulders.
Squeeze back together along the same arc.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
howto: Set both pulleys high; take a staggered stance, one foot forward.
Lean slightly forward from the hips, arms wide at shoulder height.
Pull the handles down and across in front of your chest until your hands meet.
Return slowly to the start, controlling the stretch.

exercises.name: Pec Deck (Machine Fly)
howto: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your mid-chest.
Sit tall with your back flat against the pad.
Bring the handles together in front of you, squeezing the chest.
Return slowly until you feel a light chest stretch.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
howto: Set the seat so handles sit at your mid-chest.
Keep your back against the pad and shoulder blades pinched.
Press the handles until your arms are almost straight.
Return under control; don't let your shoulders round forward.

exercises.name: Push-Up
howto: Start in a plank, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower until your chest nearly touches the floor, elbows ~45°.
Keep core and glutes braced so hips don't sag.
Press back up to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
howto: Grip the bars, lean your torso slightly forward.
Lower your body until your upper arms are near parallel to the floor.
Keep elbows out slightly and chest proud.
Press up until arms are straight; don't bounce at the bottom.

exercises.name: Deadlift
howto: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down, grip just outside your legs; brace your core and flatten your back.
Drive through the floor, keeping the bar close to your shins and thighs.
Stand tall and lock out with glutes; lower under control.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
howto: Hang from the bar with a slightly wider than shoulder-width, overhand grip.
Drive your elbows down as you pull your chest toward the bar.
Keep your shoulders back and core tight; avoid swinging.
Lower to a full hang under control.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
howto: Grip the bar underhand, shoulder-width, arms fully extended.
Pull until your chin passes the bar, elbows driving down.
Keep your body still and chest up.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
howto: Set the thigh pad; grip the bar just outside shoulder-width.
Lean back slightly, chest up, and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Drive elbows down and slightly back.
Return slowly under control to full extension.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
howto: Hinge to ~45°, back flat, knees soft, bar hanging at arm's length.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Keep your torso fixed; don't yank with momentum.
Lower under control without rounding your back.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
howto: Support yourself with one hand on a bench, back flat.
Let the dumbbell hang at arm's length from your shoulder.
Row it to your hip, driving your elbow back.
Lower slowly without twisting your torso.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
howto: Sit tall, chest up, knees slightly bent, feet braced.
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Keep your torso upright; avoid swinging back.
Return until your arms are straight but shoulders stay back.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
howto: Set the rope/bar high; face the cable with a slight forward lean.
Keep your arms nearly straight throughout.
Pull the attachment down to your thighs, driving your lats.
Return up slowly until you feel a stretch; don't use momentum.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
howto: Hold a barbell at arm's length, feet shoulder-width.
Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Don't roll your shoulders; move vertically only.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Hyperextension)
howto: Set the pad around hip height; secure your heels.
Start with your torso bent ~90°, back flat.
Raise your torso until it's in line with your legs.
Lower under control; don't hyperextend past straight.

exercises.name: Overhead Barbell Press
howto: Grip the bar just outside shoulder-width, resting on your upper chest/front delts.
Brace core and squeeze glutes to protect your lower back.
Press straight up, moving your head back as the bar clears.
Lock out overhead, then lower to your chest under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
howto: Sit (or stand) with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press both weights straight overhead until arms are straight.
Keep the weights in line with your shoulders; don't flare ribs.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
howto: Set the seat so handles are level with your shoulders.
Keep your back against the pad throughout.
Press the handles up until arms are straight.
Lower under control to just below your ears.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
howto: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, soft elbows, palms in.
Raise your arms out to the sides until shoulders height.
Lead with your elbows, not your hands.
Lower slowly; avoid swinging or shrugging.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
howto: Stand side-on to a low cable, handle in the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Keep your body tall and still.
Lower under control; hold the stretch briefly.

exercises.name: Front Raise
howto: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms down.
Raise one arm straight forward to shoulder height.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.
Lower slowly; don't lean back or swing.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Reverse Fly)
howto: Hinge forward with a flat back (seated or using a bench).
Hold dumbbells hanging below your chest, palms in.
Raise your arms out to the sides, squeezing the rear delts.
Lower slowly; keep your back flat and chest down.

exercises.name: Face Pull
howto: Set a rope attachment to a cable at upper-chest/face height.
Grip the rope with palms facing each other, step back to tension.
Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the ends apart at the end.
Finish with hands by your ears and elbows high; return slowly.

exercises.name: Upright Row
howto: Hold the bar at arm's length, hands about shoulder-width.
Pull the bar up along your body, elbows leading.
Stop at upper-chest level (or just above) to protect the shoulders.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
howto: Stand with the bar at hip level, underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar up while keeping elbows pinned to your sides.
Don't swing your hips or lean back.
Lower slowly to full extension.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
howto: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl them up, keeping elbows close to your body.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly; avoid rocking.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
howto: Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in (neutral grip).
Curl the weights up, keeping the neutral grip throughout.
Keep elbows pinned to your sides.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
howto: Set the seat so your armpits rest on the top pad.
Grip the bar underhand, arms fully extended over the pad.
Curl up until your forearms are nearly vertical.
Lower slowly without letting your elbows lift.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
howto: Sit back on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the dumbbells up, palms facing forward.
Let your upper arms stay still; squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel a full stretch.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
howto: Sit, brace your elbow against the inside of your thigh.
Let the dumbbell hang at arm's length, palm forward.
Curl it up toward your shoulder without moving your elbow.
Lower slowly; keep your wrist straight.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
howto: Attach a straight/ez bar to the low pulley.
Curl the bar up with elbows pinned to your sides.
Keep your torso still throughout the set.
Lower slowly against the cable tension.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
howto: Grip the bar about shoulder-width or slightly narrower.
Pinch shoulder blades, feet planted; keep elbows tight to your sides.
Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press up to lockout, keeping elbows close.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
howto: Set the rope/bar at a high pulley; grip with elbows at your sides.
Press the attachment down until your arms are straight.
Keep elbows fixed; don't let them drift forward.
Return slowly to elbows just past 90°.

exercises.name: Rope Pushdown
howto: Hold the rope, elbows tucked at your sides.
Push down, splitting the rope ends apart at the bottom.
Keep your elbows still and torso upright.
Return under control until the forearms are slightly above parallel.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
howto: Hold a dumbbell over your head with both hands.
Lower it behind your head, elbows pointing forward and close.
Go until you feel a good triceps stretch.
Extend back up until arms are straight.

exercises.name: Skull Crushers
howto: Lie back, hold the bar over your chest, arms straight.
Lower the bar to your forehead, bending only at the elbows.
Keep your upper arms perpendicular to the floor.
Extend back to lockout; don't let elbows flare.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
howto: Support yourself on bars, arms straight, torso upright.
Lower your body until your upper arms are near parallel to the floor.
Keep elbows tucked along your sides.
Press back up; avoid going so deep that your shoulders ache.

exercises.name: Back Squat
howto: Rack the bar on your upper traps; feet shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out.
Brace your core and keep a neutral spine.
Sit down between your hips, bringing thighs to at least parallel.
Drive up through the whole foot; keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Leg Press
howto: Set the seat so your knees reach ~90° at the bottom.
Unlock the sled; press until your legs are almost straight.
Keep your lower back and glutes on the pad.
Return under control; never let the knees collapse inward.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
howto: Align the machine's pivot with your knees.
Extend your legs until they're straight, squeezing your quads.
Keep your hips down and grip the handles.
Lower slowly without letting the weight drop.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
howto: Place feet shoulder-width on the platform, back against the pad.
Unlock the safeties and lower until your thighs are at least parallel.
Keep your lower back pressed into the pad.
Drive back up through your heels.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
howto: Rest your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, torso upright.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive up through the front heel; stay balanced.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
howto: Stand with the bar at hip level, knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back and sliding the bar down your thighs.
Lower to mid-shin (or until hamstring stretch) keeping a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, squeezing the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
howto: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels.
Keep your hips pressed into the bench.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly to full extension.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
howto: Set the pad just above your ankles; align your knees with the pivot.
Curl the pad down toward your hamstrings.
Keep your hips down and back flat.
Return slowly under control.

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
howto: Hold the bar at hip height, knees nearly straight.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back and sliding the bar down your legs.
Go until you feel a strong hamstring stretch (typically mid-shin).
Return by driving hips forward; keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.name: Good Morning
howto: Rest the bar high on your traps, feet hip-width, knees soft.
Brace your core and hinge at the hips, pushing them back.
Lower your torso toward parallel with a flat back.
Return by driving your hips forward; keep your lumbar neutral.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
howto: Kneel with your ankles held securely under a bench/partner.
Start with a straight line from knees to head, hips extended.
Lower your torso as slowly as you can by resisting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands and press back up.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
howto: Rest your upper back on a bench, bar padded over your hips.
Plant your feet under your knees.
Drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze glutes at the top; lower slowly.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
howto: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat near your hips.
Drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze glutes at the top.
Lower slowly; don't arch your lower back.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
howto: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley; face the machine.
Lean slightly forward, holding it for support.
Kick your leg back and up, squeezing the glute.
Lower slowly under control; avoid arching your back.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
howto: Stand with feet wide, toes pointed out; grip the bar inside your knees.
Drop your hips, flare your knees open, brace your core.
Drive the floor away with the bar close to your body.
Lock out hips and knees together, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Step-Up
howto: Stand facing a bench at knee-to-upper-thigh height.
Place one foot fully on the bench, push through it to step up.
Bring the trailing knee up to hip height (optional).
Step down under control; keep the chest tall.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
howto: Place the balls of your feet on the platform, heels hanging off.
With a soft knee, lower your heels for a deep stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top; lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
howto: Sit with the pad on your knees and the balls of your feet on the platform.
Let your heels sink for a stretch.
Press up onto your toes, rising as high as possible.
Lower slowly and pause at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
howto: Put the balls of your feet at the bottom edge of the platform.
Release the safeties and let the platform stretch your heels down.
Press up through your toes until your calves are fully flexed.
Lower slowly; don't bounce.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
howto: Set up in the machine (or with a partner on your hips), toes on the platform.
Lower your heels for a deep stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause at the top; lower slowly.

exercises.name: Crunch
howto: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, hands behind your head (no pulling).
Brace your abs and curl your shoulder blades off the floor.
Keep your lower back on the ground.
Lower slowly; breathe out as you curl up.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
howto: Hang from a bar with a firm grip; keep your shoulders down.
Raise your legs straight (or knees to chest) until your hips almost fold.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Plank
howto: Set up on forearms and toes, elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze glutes and abs to form a straight line from head to heels.
Don't let hips sag or pike up.
Hold with even breathing; stop if form breaks.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
howto: Attach a rope to a high pulley; kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope at your head, hands by your ears.
Crunch down, curling your ribs toward your pelvis.
Keep hips still; return up under control.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
howto: Sit with knees bent and lean back to about 45°.
Hold a weight at your chest and lift your feet (optional).
Rotate your torso side to side, tapping the floor beside your hip.
Keep your spine tall and twist from the ribs.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
howto: Kneel behind the wheel, palms on the handles, back flat.
Roll forward slowly, keeping your hips extended and core braced.
Go only as far as you can without arching your lower back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
howto: Lie flat, hands behind your head, knees lifted.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Alternate sides in a slow, controlled pedaling motion.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
howto: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet anchored.
Place hands across your chest or behind your head.
Curl up to a full sit-up, keeping your lower back from arching.
Lower back down with control; breathe out on the way up.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
howto: Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms up, bar in hands.
Allow your wrists to extend slightly down.
Curl the bar up using only your wrists.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
howto: Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms facing down, bar in hands.
Let your wrists drop slightly to a relaxed position.
Raise the backs of your hands up as high as possible.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
howto: Grip the bar overhand (palms down), hands about shoulder-width.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, elbows pinned.
Keep the overhand grip throughout.
Lower slowly; don't use momentum.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
howto: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand; stand tall.
Keep shoulders back and core braced.
Walk with short, steady steps.
Keep the wait in place; don't let your torso lean.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller
howto: Hold the roller with both hands at chest height, arms extended.
Wind the weight up by rolling your wrists.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Unwind slowly back down without letting it crash.
